name: spip-plugin/markdown-editor
description: Éditeur de texte Markdown pour SPIP (fork md_editor)

tests-integration: if [ ! -f vendor/spip/spip/config/connect.php ]; then echo 'SPIP local non installé.' >&2; if [ -t 0 ]; then printf 'Lancer composer install-spip-test ? [Y/n] ' >&2; read -r r; case "$r" in n|N) exit 1 ;; *) composer install-spip-test || exit 1 ;; esac; else echo 'Lancez: composer install-spip-test' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi
